name: @shim-works/spackle
description: Runtime polyfills for slow hardware (smart TV, set-top box, kiosks, etc) — Chrome >= 38 / Safari >= 7.1, built to avoid retaining memory rather than to match core-js
author: Sam Seabourn

scripts.build: tsup && node scripts/downlevel-es5.mjs dist/index.global.js && npm run verify:es5
scripts.build:bundle: tsup --config tsup.bundle.config.ts && node scripts/downlevel-es5.mjs spackle.js && node scripts/verify-es5.mjs spackle.js
scripts.release:alpha: git diff --quiet HEAD && npm whoami && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm version prerelease --preid alpha && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --tag alpha
scripts.release: git diff --quiet HEAD && npm whoami && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
